source: ADR-0050, 2026-09-25. Numbers are configuration under ADR-0031, not constants.
closed_after_polled_runs_note: A posting has closed when absent from its board on this many consecutive runs that polled it. The chat's starting value, approved by the operator 2026-09-25, unmeasured.
retire_after_days_note: Classified rows are stored and leave Jobs, rejection copies are deleted, and closed rows are retired this many days after their clock starts. The operator's figure, carried from ADR-0046.
unreviewed_after_days_note: ADR-0055's clock: a row nobody classified leaves Jobs this many days after it was first seen, stored with the reason unreviewed-aged-out first. The chat's starting value, approved by the operator 2026-09-28: double the fifteen-day retention.
clearing_dry_run_valid_hours_note: ADR-0055's tool removes nothing unless a dry run of the same table and threshold ran on this branch within this many hours. The implementing seat's value, approved by the operator 2026-09-30: long enough to read the dry run's report and decide the next day.
run_log_window_note: How many recent run logs the closure test reads: thirty days at two runs a day.
budget_warning_note: Say so loudly when the month's Airtable calls pass this share of the allowance before this day of the month. ADR-0050's guard; ADR-0004 says why the warning must be ours.
